Description

A formidable foe with large horns that positively crackle with electricity. It's a distance cousin of the behemoth with more of yellow tint to it.

Defense

AC 23, touch 8; flat-footed 23 (+15 natural, -2 size)

hp 207 [288] (18d10+108)

Fort +16, Ref +11, Will +7

DR 5/adamantine

Immune bleed, curse, daze, stun

Resist Water 50%

Offense

Speed 40 ft.

Melee 2 Claws +25 (1d8+9), Gore +23 (2d6+9)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Fists of Lightning and Thunder, Impale, Thunderbolt

Statistics

Str 28, Dex 11, Con 20, Int 6, Wis 12, Cha 8

Base Atk +18; CMB +28; CMD 38

Feats Alertness, Charge Through, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Overrun, Multiattack, Power Attack, Toughness

Skills Acrobatics +12, Climb +17, Perception +17, Survival +13

description.value: When charging, a kuza beast deals double damage with gore.

Once every 1d4+1 rounds, a kuza beast can cause its natural attacks to do either lightning or thunder damage (caster's choice). A lightning attack deals an additional 3d6 points of lightning damage, and the resulting flash blinds the target for 2d6 rounds, a successful Fortitude save (DC 20) negates the blindness. A thunder attack deals an additional 3d6 points of non-elemental damage, and the resulting thunderclap deafens the target for 2d6 rounds, a successful Fortitude save (DC 23) negates the deafness. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds, a kuza beast can discharge a large lightning storm within 120 ft. and in a 40-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 10d6 points of lightning damage and are inflicted with Static status effect for 1d4 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 20) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).
